This was my first assignment for the Cloud and Advanced Analytics course: a Streamlit app to search a movie database stored in BigQuery. It later grew into my [CineMatch](../cinematch/index.qmd) recommender.  

[Live app](https://movie-app-97118476415.europe-west6.run.app)

# *Features*  

- Search by title  
- Filter by language, genre, release year and average rating  
- Poster, overview, cast and runtime from the TMDB API  

# *The SQL behind it*  

Every filter you set adds a condition to one BigQuery query, and filters you leave empty are skipped. The rating filter is the most interesting one because it needs a `JOIN` with the ratings table and a `HAVING` on the average:
```
SELECT m.title, m.genres, m.release_year,
       ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
       COUNT(r.rating) AS num_ratings
FROM movies_db m
JOIN movie_ratings r ON m.movieId = r.movieId
WHERE m.language = 'en'
  AND m.genres LIKE '%Comedy%'
  AND m.release_year >= 2000
GROUP BY m.movieId, m.title, m.genres, m.release_year
HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 50
```
All the SQL that runs is printed in the terminal, which made debugging much easier.

# *Deploying it*  

The app is packaged with a Dockerfile and deployed on Google Cloud Run. The `.dockerignore` makes sure no credentials end up in the image.
